reviews.t: Tekla & Jon did a fabulous job creating & installing our new railing! I now have a work of art on our entry stairs. Wonderful caring people that took to heart what we wanted. Highly recommended!

The studio definitely deserves nothing short of a 5 star review. All the ironwork is made on the site by the Howachyns. Drop by if you’re in town or consider if you need railings or any other custom work. It lives up to the motto “we’ll forge your fantasy.” The studio has way more invintoey than the online store, so it pays to go there.

We just had railing installed at our home. We couldn't be happier. Dan listened to what are vision of what we were looking for, and delivered a finished product that fit perfectly into our existing natural rock stairs and garden.
Teresa is a go getter and a very knowledgeable business owner, I Loved meeting her and seeing her beautiful unique metal fabrication. I will be referring her to all my friends.
